changes: First stable release of the 2.7 line, succeeding the 2.6.x beta series and completing the migration of every load balancer to the cluster API (mode 2).

Load balancers (BREAKING): the legacy /api link — an unenrolled node reaching MAIN's database and Redis with the stream password — is gone; every node now uses the cluster API (mode 2). The upgrade gate now blocks a node still below mode 2 from updating to 2.7.0 so it cannot strand: re-provision or promote it to mode 2 first (ADR 0004).

Cluster reliability: event batches and divergence writes that lose an InnoDB deadlock are now retried instead of dropped, the command bus has an RPC limit, enqueue backoff and a per-node sequence lock, seed memory is estimated before loading stream rows, and a node reads its stream row from MAIN while its own store is still unseeded — far fewer deadlocks and stalls on busy mode-2 clusters.

Per-customer bouquet ordering: admins can reorder a customer's bouquets with up/down buttons under Manage Lines → Edit → Bouquets. The order is saved per customer, kept through unrelated edits, mirrored to paired MAG devices, and reset to the global order by a bulk bouquet replacement; a stale form is rejected before it can overwrite a newer order.
Resellers: new per-reseller bouquet controls and permissions, and reseller-generated codes and download links now use the reseller's own domain instead of MAIN's.
Manage Servers: Cluster Nodes is folded into a single Manage Servers page — node mode, enrolment, cutover and per-flow controls all live there.
Live streams: new quick-action tools and MAG connection details in the admin stream view, and MAIN stream controls are dispatched directly rather than through the admin HTTP relay.
Ministra / MAG portal: the category-name alias is kept for audioclub, VOD and series, and adult categories use the canonical "for adults" alias so the PIN is no longer prompted twice.
IPv6: bare IPv6 addresses are bracketed in generated panel, stream and playlist URLs, and nginx listens on IPv6 on hosts whose kernel has an IPv6 stack.
Panel robustness: array reads that were logging warnings are guarded, a batch of verified bug fixes carried over from Parches is applied, and the episodes table sort map is aligned to its columns.

Interface: a note icon appears next to the actions button in Lines, MAG and Enigma rows that carry an admin note; a shared Bosnian / Serbian / Croatian (BA_SRB_CRO) locale is added and the German labels are refined.
